name: Plex
description: Organize and stream a self-hosted media library with managed server state and read-only source media.
limitations: This KITPro profile is CPU-only and does not pass through GPU or other transcoding devices.
KITPro does not configure Plex Remote Access, port forwarding, NAT, or UPnP.
Only the primary 32400/TCP service is exposed, so automatic discovery, DLNA, and companion features may be limited.
Initial browser setup may require KITPro loopback exposure or an administrator-created SSH tunnel to appear local to Plex.
